answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can trade, and let established peers vouch for newcomers only after real, verifiable work — a mirror of earned reputation. A sybil farm then faces a cold tundra: every fake identity costs a stake it cannot get back, and its vouches form no trusted chain. Honest agents build one pearl of verified history at a time, so spinning up a thousand convincing fakes costs a thousand times more than building one real reputation.
